name: Chao bo
summary: Beef porridge on a beef-bone broth, full of tendon, bone, and offal, with scallion and sawtooth herb. The broth is rich, fragrant, and slightly hot from the herbs.
taste: The portal says the broth is rich, fragrant, and slightly hot from the herbs.
howToEat: Order a bowl, with gỏi bò, the beef salad served beside it.
seoTitle: Chao bo — Quy Nhon beef porridge
seoDescription: Quy Nhon cháo bò is beef-bone porridge with tendon, bone, and offal, rich and fragrant, served with a plate of gỏi bò.
